title: RetrieveRequest
description: Request to retrieve relevant chunks without generating an answer.

rerank.description: Per-request rerank control. null (default) preserves the server-wide default; false forces a rerank skip; true is a no-op when no reranker is wired.

rerank_candidates.description: Override for the candidate-pool depth fed to the reranker. null (default) uses the server default (max(top_k, server's rerank_candidates)).

collection.description: Registry collection id to retrieve from. null (default) uses the default collection; an unknown id returns 404. See GET /v1/collections.

retrieval_mode.description: Retrieval legs: hybrid (dense + BM25, RRF-fused), vector (dense only), or bm25 (sparse only). The graph leg is orthogonal (use_graph).

context_window.description: Server-side context expansion (issue #322): after fusion, rerank and the top_k cut, walk each returned source's prev_chunk_id / next_chunk_id up to this many hops each way and attach the neighbours as the Source's context (ranking unchanged; never merged into the scored list). Scoped by the same filters and tenant scope as the retrieval; a neighbour the caller may not read is omitted; a neighbour that is itself a returned source is not duplicated. 0 (default) leaves the response as before. Above 3 is a 422.

reranker.description: Registered model id to rerank with for THIS request only. Unknown id 404; non-reranker model 400. See GET /v1/models/available.
